ledger: hand | moving green block '2' on table | adjusting blocks | shifts and manipulates blocks
block sequence | starts with two green '2' blocks | ends with nine numbered blocks (2,3,2,2,3,5,2,6,3) | blocks morph, change color, and multiply spontaneously

findings.description: The green block '2' on the left morphs into a blue block '2', and a blue block '3' spontaneously appears alongside it.
The digit '2' printed on the green block morphs into a digit '3' as the hand touches it.
Additional blocks (orange '2', blue '3', green '5', green '2', blue '6') spontaneously emerge out of thin air as the hand slides the block to the right.
